title: Two-for-one has a boundary
hook: A promotion can change its effective price when you need an odd quantity.

knows: that a model can declare hypothetical quantities
doesNotKnow: Account for indivisible promotional bundles and odd demand.

misconception: Two-for-one always halves the checkout cost for the exact quantity needed.
objective: Account for indivisible promotional bundles and odd demand.

claims.text: Singles cost €3 each. A two-for-one pair costs €4; pairs are indivisible. Scaled model; fictional offer; pair-only purchase.
claims.source: Declared hypothetical inputs and limits in resource-specs.json. No actual product, price, tariff, shelf-life, treatment or physical appliance specification is asserted. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: The stage's two results are computed by the printed expressions. At Items=3, A=€9 and B=€8. Geometry follows the declared dimension relationships. Other pictures use a fixed full scale across the slider range; continuous fills and arcs show relative amounts rather than literal object counts.
